acceptanceCriteria: `sh script/gate-affected_test.sh` exits 0 on main, with the deleted-file expectation matching what script/gate-affected.sh actually prints (or the script restored to print the frontier line, whichever the AFP-V0-011/012 contract requires).
A failed expect_line prints the missing line and the observed output instead of exiting silently.
body: Reproduced 2026-10-12 on origin/main 9deae4838 (clean ~/projects/corvint-main, Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 456): `sh script/gate-affected_test.sh` exits 1 with no output. Under `sh -x` the deleted-file case runs script/gate-affected.sh, which prints `gate-affected: selected ...` and `gate-affected: run ...` lines, then expect_line greps for `gate-affected: frontier example.com/fixture/core <- core/core.go`, which the script never emits; set -e then exits without a failure message. Expected: the test passes, or reports which expectation failed. Actual: rc=1, silent. Found while integrating V1-0040 slice 3 (script/gate-affected.sh is kept there as the rollback; script/gate-affected-corvint_test.sh passes).
title: script/gate-affected_test.sh fails silently: deleted-file case expects a frontier line gate-affected.sh never prints
